tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// saṃbarṇeṣṭarthādhyaṣaṇasyagathābrahmakabyarbaṇāyāshshabhaswaranāmabhagawāmunīnādharmodakt+yabhadanāshilaratnashtsamantitābhināyābidzaharaṃ// ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po dang chos smra ba'i slob dpon shī la ratnar bod pa dbyer med du bstod cing 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa tshangs sras 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ mnyam pa'i britta bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi dgongs par nyis stong zhe brgyad mchis pa'i nang gsal sum brgya nga bdun pa dbang po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i prastās bcings pa'o//

༄༅// yaṃshāraṇaṃgatyabhawashtsashānto/ trāṇābhayādantagayoḥ.abastha/ hītassukhasyāsanasaukhyadānaḥ shreyaprayatstshantugurutriratnaiḥ ༄༅// nang shes byed kyi rgyu'i shis par brjod pa/ gang la skyabs su song rnams srid dang zhi'i// 'jigs pa las bsgral gnas skabs mthar thug gi /phan bde'i go 'phang bde blag nyid ster ba// bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi dge legs stsol// dpag yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa/ yas bskal pa'i tshogs zung mthar phyin nas// stobs dang mi 'jigs dran nyer thugs rje che'i// yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab 'jig rten gsum// legs gsungs snang chen 'gyed pa thub mchog dang*// tshuṃl khriṃms ting baidharba'i rab dwangs/ nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi// bslab pa'i gnas la gus shing gzhan dag la'ang*// sdeb legs 'doms pa dkon mchog riṃn cheṃn gsum// kun 'dus yongs 'dzin dbyer med gcig tu bsngags// sdug bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ bsngal kun 'byung gnas las skyob pa'i blos// srid pa'i ltar snang bde 'byor ring skyungs nas// 'gog lam yon tan dran la mngon phyogs te// bag yod bslab pa'i gnas la brtson 'grus bskyed// mtha' dag gzugs can/ theg chen snying stobs dar bab don mthun rje// gzhan don byang chub sgrub pa dam bca'i grus// tshogs gnyis dag byed phung po legs brgal te// lung rtogs yon tan rin chen gling dbang 'byor// sngon gyi smon lam rjes dran shing rtar brten// 'gro 'dul dus bab ston pa nyin mor byed// 'pho 'jug gtam rtsed go la'i lam rgyu bas// mdzad bzang snang bas 'jig rten kun gsal mdzad// ring spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu/ nas phyi nang shes bya'i gzhung kun la// 'dris par ma sbyangs snyam pa'i som nyi ci// de phyir shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa nyid// zhal 'ches bsnyengs bral dbyangs kyis sa gsum khengs// gur gum chab kyis ma bkrus mdangs 'od gsal// tshangs pas ma bris mtshan bzang dpe byad bkra// grogs kyis ma bteg lha sogs sde brgyad kyis// gtsug gi mngon par mchod pa skyabs kyi mchog

/ sems med rab brtag dge mtshan gzi 'od 'bar ba 'gro phal gyi// lta byed yul du mi bzod bzlog pa'i slad// chos gos rnam gsum sku yi tshul khrims dri// ngoms med 'thung ba'i zol gyis 'khyud dam snyam// snyan byung ba 'gog pa/ 'gyur yan lag rdzogs pa'i dbyangs gcig gis// rigs can gsum la tha dad mos pa'i chos// cig car 'doms de mi srid yang na ni// gsung gi bkod pa dpag yas bstan par nges/ /sems med rab brtag mngon sum lkog gyur shin tu lkog gyur gyi// shes bya kun gyi mtshan nyid yongs gzigs pas// kun gsal bem chos rang gi mtshang rig nas// ngo tshas stong pa'i lus su brdzus pa snyam/ /khyad gzhi tha dad cing khyad chos gcig pa'i bsdus brjod/ rin thang chen po mi zad 'byung ba'i gzhi// rang bzhin rab dwangs nam yang rnyog pa med// dag byed 'bad med rgyun gyis lus can gyi// re skong ma dros gnas khyod skal bas thob/ /'gal ba can gyi sbyar ba/ mi mjed bdag gyur srid zhi'i mthar mi gnas// yid srubs thul yang mig gi me ma spros// kun las rgyal yang g.yo sgyu'i 'jug pas min// lha yi lha mchog bcud bral 'tshe mi byed// nyin thun mong min pa'i dpe/ mtshan sgron ma zung gis sa bla dang*// sa 'og gsal ba mi bzod rnam par 'dren// khyod kyi phrin las sa gsum gsal ba'i dpe// legs mdzad rang nyid bstan no shākya'i sras/ /byang thog ma'i gsal byed/ shin tu gsal byas bka' lung dgongs 'grel chos// dngos dang rnam 'phrul mkhas dang grub rigs kyis// rigs drug 'gro ba'i sgrib gsum sbyong ba'i thabs// rnam grol gsum gyi 'bras bu gang yin nyid// nam mkha'i 'bru mang tshig bsdud/ mkhyen pa mkha' klong thugs rje can// char gyi nus pas dge legs dbyar skyes tshogs// legs spyad thub pa mchog dang tshuṃl khriṃms gsum// gtsug lag riṃn cheṃn 'od 'phro thabs gcig nyid// che

zur gyi phra mo/ ba'i yon tan rgyas pa snyan dngags glur// mnyan pa 'dod rnams zla ba'i ma ma cher// ku sha'i sdong bus thigs pa blangs pa'i mthar// thal mo steng 'og khong stong sbyar ba ltos/ /yan lag gsum gzugs/ 'on te dad gsum zor mo'i zlos gar gyis// phyogs re'i che brjod tambu ra yi rgyud// legs 'khrol snyan dngags bstod pa'i dbyangs 'jo zhing*// grangs med sprul pa'i lus btud phyag bgyi'o/ /'byor ba rgya che ba/ bsags pa'i longs spyod lus dang dge bar bcas// nyer spyod phreng ba rgyal srid bkra shis rtags// 'dod yon gya nom dpag yas nam mkha'i khams// dog por bgyid snyam sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyi mchod// ring nas dug yan lag gcig gzugs/ gsum kun nas bslangs pa'i las// mi dge dam tshig sdom pa'i nyes ltung tshogs// gnyan po stobs bzhi tshang bas mthol bshags na// dag byed thugs rje'i gaṅgā dbab tu gsol// kha 'byung bzhi dpe/ ba'i rdul brtsegs lhun por bsil sbyin 'od// khyab par brtse dang byang chub sems mnga' na// 'phags dang so skyes bsags pa'i bsod nams la// yi rang 'dzum gyi bklubs bgyi rkang pa 'jog / thob bya'i rgyu/ mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i bcings pa'i legs bshad dbyangs// thos reg bsgom pa'i phan yon dran pa'i blos// yid srub bye ba'i thabs kyis mi bslu bar// theg gsum chos kyi snang chen 'gyed par bskul// smra 'bad pas 'gog pa/ mchog mya ngan 'da' la mngon phyogs rnams// bzhed pa 'gog pa'i zhu ba mi sems kyang*// mtha' med 'gro ba'i brtan brling bral dogs kyis// bskal mang brtan par bzhugs pa gsol ba 'debs// 'dis skyed byed kyi rgyu'i shis brjod/ mtshon dus gsum dge bas ring mo nas// phan 'dogs kyis skyong 'gro rnams sdug bsngal che// de rgyu bcas las nges par skyob byed pa'i// thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob byed gyur/

/yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ tshul 'dis bstod pa'i bsod nams phung po'i mthar// gzhal bya nyid dam yid 'phrog gzugs kyi dpal// 'dzin pa min yang deng nas rnam mkhyen bar// bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas gang yin te/ /thun mong min pa'i dpe/ sems can re skong dbyig las ches lhag pa'i// 'di phyi byang chub bar gyi mchog ster ba// rgyal ba'i phrin las mtshungs zla ma rnyed pas// rang nyid dper bstan gong de bdag thob shog /de thob cha shas gzugs can/ bar gyi tshe rabs las bzang gi /bi shwa karmas dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i lus// ngo mtshar sprul te srid las nges 'byung blos// dkon mchog rnam gsum skyabs su thob gyur cig /rang bzhin brjod pa/ bstan pa tshul bzhin 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen las// so thar sems bskyed sngags kyi sdom pa rnams// rim mam cig car thob pa gang rung gi /sdom pa nyes ltung med par bskyong bar shog /chos dpe/ shes bya bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung rnams la// thos dang bsam pas legs dpyod zab mo'i don// bsgom byung blo gros nyi 'od ltar 'tsher bas// sangs rgyas bstan la mkhas pa'i las byed shog /skyed byed rgyu/ mdo dang rgyud kyi brjod bya sdom pa gsum// char gtogs bcas pa'i legs gsungs mgrin 'jo bas// sna tshogs gdul bya'i mos pa tha dad snod// chos tshul de de'i 'gengs pa'i byed por shog /bsdus dang ma bsdus bsres pa'i gzugs can/ brgal brtag lung dang rigs pa'i dga' byed mdas// log par smra ba'i bde bral mgo bo dral// sgrub phyogs rnam dag sī ta rang dbang du// khug pa'i dga' ston longs su spyod par shog /'khor mtshungs gsal dpe/ 'das chos rnams thams cad rgyan gsum lam// song ba'i legs bshad mi zad rtag 'jo bas// skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun la co 'dri bas// 'phags dang so skye'i mkhas pa dgyes byed shog

/gnas skabs rim pa can/ kun du ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe// bsod nams srid dpal chos kyi 'byor pa rnams// lam gsum 'bab kyi rgyun dang ma dros gnas// legs bris bde ldan zhing gi rjes 'gror shog /bde ba bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ 'dod kyang 'dod khro gti mug gis// mi dge'i phyogs gzhol phyogs bral sems can rnams// sdug bsngal kun 'byung kun rmongs las gdon pa'i// gang 'tsham chos kyis chos la gzud par shog /ston mchog dngos thob kyi dga' ba/ thub dbang de sras chos smra ba// dbyer med skyabs su thob pa'i dga' ba 'di// gzhan las min no khyed cag skye ba kun// mgon du thob las 'byung phyir shin tu smon/ /srid min gyi dpe/ ga pur nus pas bskyed pa'i tsha ba'i rims// dbang gzhu chag pa'i dum bzhin dkon mchog gsum// bka' lung bden gtam bslus pa chos la med// bden pa de yi gang smras 'grub gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po dang chos smra ba'i slob dpon shī la ratnar bod pa dbyer med du bstod cing 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa tshangs sras 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad pa'i nor can kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i zhal 'don du 'di bzhin dgos tshul dzā ti'i dri bsung lta bu'i bskur ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung bar 'os pa'i yon tan la smon pa'i bod phyogs su/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyan pa'i lang tsho'i sder btags pas rab byung me zla'i rnam 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bgrang gzhi'i zhag gi phung po rta chen gyi nya ba'i hor lugs kyi zla ba dang po'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i lha yi bla ma rgyal sar phebs pa'i nyin grub par bgyis ba sarbārtha siddhaṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// slob dpon padmā ka ra la gsol ba 'debs pa nyung ngu bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// zab yangs tshogs gnyis rab dwangs rgya mtsho'i gling*// srid gsum skyon bral chu skyes ge sar khrod// brdzus skyes sprul sku snyigs dus 'gro ba la// thugs rje ches myur padmā ka rar 'dud// gsang gsum byin rlabs nyi zer lhung ba'i mod// 'jig rten dregs pa'i rnam 'tshe'i 'ching rgya bsal// bde dga' dpal 'byor 'dab stong tshal bzhad pa'i// byed po padma rgyal po la phyag 'tshal// gus pas bstod cing gsol ba 'debs byed pa// bstan pa'i rjes zhugs rig pa 'dzin gzugs bdag /gdon bgegs 'byung po'i dpung las rnam rgyal nas// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// ces slob dpon padmā ka ra la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa nyung ngu bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni don gnyer dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bskur ba'i ngor/ bande tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// gser chos lugs kyi seng gdong ma'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rdo rje 'chang chen dpa' mo seng ge'i gdong*// dgra las rnam rgyal rdo rje gdan pa che// don yod rdo rje ba ri lo tsā ba// brtse chen snying po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams rtse mo rje btsun grags rgyal mtshan// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang brag phug bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun dga' bkra shis ngang tshul bzang po can// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan blo gros bzang po dang*// mkhyen rab chos rje lo chen chos skyong bzang*// sa skya lo rtsā rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog lhun grub dkon mchog dpal ldan dang*// shar chen kun bkras sher 'byung kun dga' legs// sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// bkra shis lhun grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// shī la ratna la sogs byin rlabs dang*// las tshogs legs 'doms bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon// yi dam zhi khro seng gdong rigs lnga dang*// bstan srung nor lhar bcas la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma skyabs gsum nor bu gtsug 'chang ba'i// byang chub sems rtsal rdzogs pa'i skyes bu des// tshogs gnyis zung 'jug lam du gom bkod cing*// sku gnyis 'thob bya'i grong khyer phyin par shog

/stong nyid rdo rje'i gur khyim 'bar ba'i nang*// dur khrod chos 'byung pad nyi bam chen steng*// seng zhal 'jigs ma'i gzugs sku bsgom pa'i mthus// snod bcud tha mal snang zhen bzlog tu gsol// dpa' mo gang gi sku gsung thugs gsang ba// bsgom bzlas brtson pa'i nus pas rang gzhan gyi// sgo gsum gzhom bral rdo rje'i bsrung ba la// bdud dgra bye ba'i co 'dris mi tshugs mdzod// phrag dog dug myos mi bsrun dgra bgegs dang*// byad mkhan sbrul gdug khros pa'i kha rlangs dug /phyir bzlog sngags kyi 'thor rlung drag po yis// gnod byed gang yin brlag cing gtong du gsol// kun rtog 'khrugs pa'i dgra bgegs snang ba rnams// rnam par dpyad ngor skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi// blo 'das dbyings su sbyor sgrol mkhas 'gyur ba'i// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces gser chos lugs kyi seng gdong ma'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di'ang dge slong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyi ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
